gaps.sentence: The committee ___ of eight members and two advisers.
gaps.explanation: 'Consist of' = be made up of; 'composes of' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: After twenty years of service, she is one of our most ___ employees.
gaps.explanation: 'A valued member/employee' is someone the organisation appreciates; 'valuable' stresses monetary or practical worth.

gaps.sentence: I ___ seeing that man somewhere before.
I'm exhausted — I need to ___ down and rest.
gaps.hint: to recline — no object; forms: lie, lay, lain
gaps.explanation: 'Lie' (lie, lay, lain) means to recline and takes no object; 'lay' (lay, laid, laid) means to put something down and takes an object.

gaps.sentence: Pens, envelopes and paper are sold in the ___ department.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationery' means writing materials; 'stationary' is an adjective meaning not moving.
